coverage.member: FusionTextBox(this InputBoundField<TModel, TProp> setup, Action<TextBoxBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionTextBox builder stops rendering the field bound to the model value (the test asserts the profile opens with the input showing 'Margaret' and the directory preview reading 'Margaret')

coverage.member: AddAppendIcon(this ComponentRef<FusionTextBox, TModel> self, string iconCssClass)
coverage.catches: AddAppendIcon stops appending the search icon inside the field on DomReady (the test asserts exactly one .e-icons.e-search element inside the textbox input group)
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the textbox event to its plan pipeline, so typing runs no reaction and the live preview never updates
the Input event stops firing the reactive handler as the resident's name is typed, so the directory preview never reflects the keystrokes
the Input event arg contract stops delivering the input payload into the plan, so neither the preview nor the replacing-name line updates while typing
Value stops carrying the text being typed (the test types 'Margie' and asserts the directory preview reads 'Margie')
PreviousValue stops carrying the value the keystrokes are replacing (the test asserts the 'replacing the name on record' line reads 'Margaret', the value before the fill)
the Changed event stops firing when focus leaves after an edit, so the committed-name record never updates
the Changed event arg contract stops delivering the change payload into the plan, so the saved name and what-it-changed-from never appear
Value stops carrying the committed name (the test edits the name to 'Margie', blurs, and asserts 'Last saved name' reads 'Margie')
PreviousValue stops carrying the value before the commit (the test asserts 'Changed from' reads the prior 'Margaret' after committing 'Margie')

IsInteracted stops distinguishing a programmatic SetValue (false -> 'Filled from the resident's record.') from a hand-typed edit; the test clicks 'Use legal name' and asserts the filled-from-record message, which only renders when IsInteracted is false

coverage.member: SetValue(this ComponentRef<FusionTextBox, TModel> self, string? value)
coverage.catches: SetValue stops writing the given value onto the textbox (the test clicks 'Use legal name' and asserts the input and the directory preview both read 'Margaret Whitfield')
FocusIn stops moving focus into the field (the test clicks 'Edit name' and asserts the name input is focused)
FocusOut stops removing focus from the field (the test focuses the field via Edit name, clicks 'Done', and asserts the name input is no longer focused)
the Focus event stops firing when the dietary field receives focus, so the kitchen-staff guidance and on-file note never appear
the Focus event arg contract stops delivering the focus payload into the plan, so the on-file note line never updates on focus
Value stops carrying the note already on file at focus time (the test focuses the dietary field and asserts 'Note on file when you opened the field' reads the seeded 'No shellfish')
the Blur event stops firing when focus leaves the dietary field, so the captured-note confirmation never updates
the Blur event arg contract stops delivering the blur payload into the plan, so the captured-note line never updates on blur
Value stops carrying the note as focus leaves (the test types 'Low sodium, no shellfish', blurs, and asserts 'Captured note' reads it)
the Value source stops yielding the current textbox values into the gather body (the test asserts the POST carries "preferredName":"Margie" and "dietaryNote":"Low sodium, no shellfish")

acceptedFanout.reason: one user gesture (typing a new preferred name) with DISTINCT fails-when-broken assertions per member: the directory preview becoming 'Margie' (FusionTextBoxInputArgs.Value), the 'replacing the name on record' line becoming 'Margaret' (FusionTextBoxInputArgs.PreviousValue), and the preview/replacing lines updating at all (Input firing the handler, FusionTextBoxInputArgs delivering the payload, Reactive connecting the wiring). Each member has its own assertion in this test, not one assertion claimed for many members.
